comparison.objective: Select the correctly sized pin and seat it fully in a fixture hole.
comparison.physical_skill: Size discrimination, cross-arm handoff, coaxial insertion, and push-to-bottom seating.
comparison.success_condition: Only the 20 mm pin counts; at least 22 mm inserted, bottom within 3 mm of floor, tilt at most 7 degrees, stable for one second.
comparison.reason: It shares coaxial insertion as a generic primitive, but tests fitting and seating an intact pin rather than stabilizing a mandrel for bimanual impact, protecting a retained coil, and recovering fractured tangs.
